summary.tldr: Authorizes $115.1 billion in federal spending for the 2022-23 fiscal year.
what_it_does: Authorizes $115,056,882,851 from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for public service expenses not otherwise provided for.
Sets the spending authority for the financial year ending March 31, 2023.
Came into force on Royal Assent, which was given on June 23, 2022.
summary.background: The bill was introduced in the House of Commons on June 7, 2022, and received Royal Assent on June 23, 2022.
